templates.title: Layered reel wall behind a seated subject
templates.fidelity_notes: Real media cards and a supplied alpha subject. Does not segment people or generate missing background pixels.

templates.title: Data-backed animated line chart
templates.fidelity_notes: Chart geometry follows explicit values, labels and units. Defaults are labeled example data, never inferred performance metrics.

templates.title: Magazine masthead behind subject with cover furniture
templates.fidelity_notes: Actual behind/foreground/front layers with supplied aligned alpha media. Barcode is decorative. Does not create segmentation masks.

templates.title: Translucent embossed display type
templates.fidelity_notes: Embossed/translucent CSS treatment, not physically accurate background refraction. Optional alpha subject creates depth.

templates.title: Timed glass task checklist with progress
templates.fidelity_notes: In-player or standalone task checklist; distinct from the effect-index HUD. Completion times are explicit composition-local seconds.

templates.title: Synchronized media proof player, counter and effect index
templates.fidelity_notes: One sequence drives visible clip, highlighted row, counter and progress. Main presenter remains the base video; child clips use their own local media offsets. Not a phone screen recording generator.

templates.title: Screenshot-backed social profile CTA
templates.fidelity_notes: Uses a supplied profile screenshot; does not invent follower counts, follow users, or send DMs.
